title: Training Treats and Food Spacing for a New Pet on Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Training ring note — treats in place of meals**

Training treats stand in for part of a pet's meals, which lengthens the days between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship (opened for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship). The enrollment and its sessions are read from the customer's Tailwise Training records.

| Training enrollment of the customer | That enrollment's own sessions attended in the last 1 month | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| In status in progress | 3 or more | 9 |
| In status in progress | fewer than 3 | 4 |
| None in status in progress | — | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

Only sessions of the enrollment that is in progress count; sessions of a completed or other enrollment do not.

**Hypothetical cases.** A puppy group course in progress with sessions attended 5, 12 and 26 days ago: 9 days added. The same course with one session in the last month: 4 days added. A course completed last month and nothing in progress: none.
